# E1 — the operator's own asks (every `source=human` ledger row)

**Evidence class E1.** A row the operator wrote into the gopi task ledger is the
closest thing this system has to a *user-need record*: it is a human stating
what they want built, fixed or changed, in their own words. This file is the
frozen, greppable copy of that class.

- **Source**: `/home/user/.gopi/memory.db`, table `tasks`, `where source='human'` (read-only)
- **Row count in this snapshot: 608** — machine-read from the ledger; this number must equal a
  fresh `sqlite3 /home/user/.gopi/memory.db "select count(*) from tasks where source='human'"`
- **Count handle (use this, not a visual count)**: `grep -c '^<!--row: ' devdoc/requirements/evidence/evidence-human-asks.md`
- **Snapshot boundary**: `max(created_at)` = 2026-09-18T04:42:51Z (epoch 1789706571.0); first row = 2026-08-29T14:09:46Z
- **Extraction**: `bash devdoc/requirements/evidence/extract-human-asks.sh` (script committed beside this file)
- **Determinism**: no wall-clock time is written, so a re-run over an unchanged ledger reproduces this
  file byte-for-byte. The ONE thing a re-run may differ in: rows created after the snapshot boundary,
  plus — if such rows arrive — the `Row count`/`Snapshot boundary` lines above and the
  `Class fingerprint` counts below. Nothing else shifts.

**How to cite a row** (module authors): `E1 task <task_id>` — e.g. `E1 task t-1788039140` — and quote the
summary line. The task id is unique and stable; it is also the key the rest of the ledger
(`task_events`, tags, parent_task_id) joins on.

**Honesty note, read before using this as a requirement corpus**: this class is *not* a clean set of
user stories. It contains harness bookkeeping written into the same table (see the Class fingerprint:
rows whose summary begins `gopi run`), duplicate submissions of one ask, and rows whose *reason* for
being cancelled or failed was never recorded. The fingerprint section quantifies each of those, and the
companion `evidence-index.md` carries the full "what is NOT recorded" accounting.

---

|---|---|
| `total source=human rows` | 608 |

| `payload/spec text ABSENT (summary only)` | 10 |
| `summary under 40 chars AND no payload (thinnest asks)` | 1 |
| `tags present` | 573 |
| `parent_task_id set (follow-up of another ask)` | 29 |
| `rows sharing a summary text with another row (duplicate submissions)` | 29 |
| `cancelled WITH empty reason (why it was dropped: lost)` | 21 |
| `failed WITH empty reason (why it broke: lost)` | 9 |

|---|---|

| `cancelled` | 70 |

## The rows

Format per row — the marker line is the authoritative count handle and the row
boundary (text inside a summary or payload may itself look like markdown, so
never count headings):

    <!--row: <task_id>-->
    ### <task_id>
    - created: <ISO-8601 UTC> | epoch: <created_at as stored>
    - status: <status> | tags: <tags> | parent: <parent_task_id>
    - summary:   <- the operative line
    <summary verbatim>
    - spec/payload:   <- the full spec when the operator wrote one
    <payload verbatim, or "(none recorded)">

Ordering: \`created_at\`, then \`task_id\` (deterministic; no locale-dependent sort).

<!--row: t-1788036628-->
### t-1788036628
- created: 2026-08-29T20:50:28Z | epoch: 1788036628.0
- status: completed | tags: big-goal,m45,notify,pa-queue | parent: pa-q-memroadmap-hermes-parity
- summary:
[BIG-GOAL][M4.5] task 状态跨节点镜像（ingest 接收端）+ 失败墓碑归档语义（nick 同意：failed 保留供审计，archive/resolved 标记让 --status failed 只显示未处置失败）

- spec/payload:
问题（nick 指出）：HP 跑的任务状态只回写 HP 本地 memory.db，peerbox 台账永远 pending（--db 不支持跨节点连接，SQLite 远程锁也不该做）。方案 A 实现：①peerbox 侧新增 gopi task ingest 轻量子命令（或 --listen 模式的 ingest server）：接收 POST JSON（复用 M3 通知钩子的 payload 格式：event/task_id/status/summary/elapsed/tokens/claimed_by）→ upsert 本地台账。安全约束：只允许前向迁移（pending/claimed→completed/failed/cancelled）+ 本地行不存在则拒绝（防伪造）+ upsert 标记 source 不变但加 remote_node 备注列或 tags 后缀 ②HP 侧配置：GOPI_TASK_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK=http://10.0.0.6:PORT/task-ingest + GOPI_TASK_NOTIFY_EVENTS=completed,failed ③幂等：重复投递不炸（upsert 语义天然幂等）④实测：HP submit 一个小任务→run→peerbox task list 看到终态自动落账 ⑤devdoc。参考：internal/tools/tasknotify.go（payload 格式）、cmd/agent/cli_tasks.go（TaskUpdate 前向迁移校验已有 taskAllowedTransitions）。工作流 GOPI.md Rule 6 worktree feat/task-ingest（peerbox 开发即可——接收端跑在 peerbox，HP 只是配置方）

<!--row: t-1788037374-->
### t-1788037374
- created: 2026-08-29T21:02:54Z | epoch: 1788037374.0
- status: completed | tags: m45,serve,pa-queue | parent: t-1788036628
- summary:
[M4.5 补充] task serve 守护化两件：单实例锁 + --skip-tag 防误领（nick 已批）

- spec/payload:
实现要求（并入 M4.5 台账治理包，与 task ingest/墓碑归档同批）：①serve 单实例锁：runTaskServe 启动时对 ~/.gopi/serve.lock 做 syscall flock（LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB），拿不到→读出持锁者 pid 打 'another serve running (pid=N), exiting' 后 os.Exit(1)；锁文件随进程死亡自动释放（flock 语义），不需要 pid 陈旧检查 ②--skip-tag TAGS 旗标（逗号分隔）：TaskNext 的 SELECT 加 NOT EXISTS/tags 过滤——tags 含任一 skip-tag 的 pending 行不领（默认建议 serve 调用方传 pa-queue——PA 占位任务的防误领；旗标本身不设默认值保持 CLI 纯粹）③实测：双 serve 并发（第二个必须立即退出且报 pid）+pa-queue 标记任务不被领 ④参考：internal/tools/tasks.go TaskNext 的 CAS 结构、cmd/agent/cli_tasks.go runTaskServe。工作流 GOPI.md Rule 6 worktree feat/serve-daemon（与 task-ingest 同期开发注意文件域：都在 cli_tasks.go/tasks.go——建议同分支连做或排后）

- spec/payload:
实现（并入 M4.5 包，task 存活追踪的最终形态——nick 两轮简化后定案）：①新列 tasklist_issued_at（ALTER TABLE 幂等模式）：todoState.update() 同路径顺带 UPDATE（internal/agent/loop.go:378-400 todoState.update 处，tasklist 块到达即写时间戳）——零计算零系数，原始事实 ②新列 last_toolcall_at（这就是 nick 说的 heartbeat 字段名）：executeToolBatch/executeToolBatchParallel 入口处轻触（internal/agent/loop.go:2921/2964，每次工具调用=活着信号，比 iteration 粒度细比定时器心跳便宜）——走 ai/au 触发器自动同步 FTS 的 updated_at 语义不变 ③stale 检测（查询侧策略非存储层预判断）：task list 或 serve tick 内一条 SELECT（status=in_progress AND now−last_toolcall_at>阈值），命中→stale 事件走现成 GOPI_TASK_NOTIFY 管道（tasknotify.go 复用，event=stale）——阈值默认值保守（如 30min），实测后数据驱动调整；不新增守护进程 ④附带修复：现役 in_progress 僵尸行（updated_at 停在创建时刻的）在新机制上线后自然可检出 ⑤实测：跑一个真实 task→last_toolcall_at 持续刷新→kill -9 进程→stale 检测命中+notify 事件落盘 ⑥devdoc。工作流 GOPI.md Rule 6 worktree feat/task-heartbeat（M4.5 包排 serve 守护化之后，同文件域）

实现（中心化架构最后一码，与 M4.6 chat 表同窗口）：①配置三源合一（传统惯例，优先级 CLI > env > settings.json）：settings.json 新段 compute_nodes: [{name,max_concurrent}]（显式白名单——绝不以 ssh config 为拓扑源）+ env 覆盖 GOPI_COMPUTE_NODES（JSON 数组字符串）+ CLI 旗标（serve 的 --nodes 参数）。help 三处都写明（gopi task serve -h + settings 文档 + config.go DEFAULT 注释）②负载均衡 dispatch（serve tick 内）：领取任务→对每个 compute_node 经 ssh 查 'gopi task list --status in_progress' 行数→count<max_concurrent 的候选中最空者→ssh <node> 'gopi task run <id>'（执行机不需要任何 tag/队列语义）→全满/ssh 不可达→本地跑或等下 tick（节点失联降级=跳过该节点并在 serve 日志记一行，不炸循环）③remote 回报协议（remote 侧任务结束时）：ssh peerbox 'gopi task update <id> --status X'（CLI 直写 peerbox 台账——双层 ssh 已验证）+git push peerbox feat/xxx；remote 的 gopi 需要 GOPI_HOME 指向本地 scratch（它自己的 settings 也用 GLM）④实测标准：a) 三源优先级各测（settings 配 A env 覆盖 B CLI 再覆盖）b) HP 端到端：peerbox serve 领到任务→负载查询 HP→ssh 派发→HP 跑完→peerbox 台账见 completed+git push back feat 分支 c) max_concurrent 边界（灌 3 个任务 max=2→第 3 个等 tick）d) 节点失联降级（iptables 断 ssh 模拟）⑤devdoc：dispatch 决策记录+拓扑声明式哲学（与 glow-moon 同构）+扩展新节点三步指南。工作流 GOPI.md Rule 6 worktree feat/remote-dispatch，与 feat/chat-table 并行注意 taskregister.go 共享——chat 表先 merge 再做本单。参考：devdoc/task-ledger-m45.md（当前 serve/ingest 基线）

- spec/payload:
修复 stale 检测的触发点孤岛：①staleSweep 提为 serve pass 第一步无条件执行（cli_tasks.go runTaskServe 循环内，领取任务之前——每 10min 必扫，零新守护进程；现状只在 task run 入口挂了导致 resume 起的任务/无任务可领时段的僵尸 10h 漏报）②resume 路径补挂同 sweep（cli_resume.go——续命实例起跑时也扫）③僵尸判定三层证据链（verify agent 用，零先验）：a) heartbeat 停（last_toolcall_at 超 30min——stale 事件自带）b) claimed_by pid 死活（notify payload 已带 claimed_by=hostname:pid，ps 查证——强证据零误报）c) session JSONL mtime 停（task 行 session_id→文件 mtime，verify agent 可查）——a+b 命中即确认僵尸→动作=task verify 走 reopened（工作重新入队）或 cancel+重派（按 payload 是否值得续判断）④proportional threshold（按 estimate 比例）留待 tasklist_issued_at 数据攒够后做，先固定 30min。实测：a) 造一个 kill -9 的 in_progress 行→serve tick 内 stale 事件落盘（不等 task run）b) pid 存活检查逻辑单测 c) resumed 路径 sweep 生效。工作流：并入 feat/chat-remote-dispatch（M4.6+M4.7 resume 续命正在跑的分支——same files cli_tasks.go）或其后续分支。

### t-1788053164
- created: 2026-08-30T01:26:04Z | epoch: 1788053164.0
- status: completed | tags: bug028,serve,pa-queue,remote:remote | parent: t-1788048877
- summary:
[bug028] task serve 的 refuse 路径 os.Exit(1) 杀掉整个守护进程：无 payload 行被领取→refuse→serve 死亡（生产 serve 三次静默死亡的根因）

- spec/payload:
发现过程：生产 serve（every 10m）三次静默死亡——每次都因领到无 payload 的 PA-QUEUE 占位行→taskRunBriefing refuse→os.Exit(1)→serve 进程退出（deamon 应 skip 该行继续循环）。修复：①runTaskRun 的 refuse 分支不再 os.Exit——返回特殊状态让 runTaskServe 的循环 skip 并继续（或领取前预检 payload 过滤无 payload 行——TaskNextFiltered 加 payload 非空过滤）②建议 TaskNextFiltered 直接加选项：只领 payload 非空的行（无 payload 行=登记行非执行行，dispatch 器根本不该碰）③实测：无 payload pending 行存在时 serve 持续存活跨多个 tick ④关联：skip-tag 匹配 tags 但 tags 会被反复打掉（HP/peerbox 双侧实证 tags 空导致误领）——payload 过滤是一劳永逸的方案。devdoc 记录+回归测试。

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 实测三种写法都 No tasks found）：HP 上 gopi task list --db peerbox:/home/user/.gopi/memory.db 静默返回空——远端 DB 路径当前不被解析，前缀被当字面路径打到本地或空库。实现只读远端查询：①--db 值解析 peerbox:/path 与 ssh:host:/path 两种前缀（host 可为 ssh config alias——传输层现成）②只读子命令白名单（task list/show/search）→ ssh host 'gopi task list --status X' 转发+原样透传 stdout（gopi CLI 即 RPC 第三次胜利：查询不复制 DB，把命令送过去）③写子命令（update/cancel 等）遇远端前缀→明确报错并指向两条正路：task ingest（webhook 镜像）或直接 ssh host 跑 CLI ④安全细节：不存在路径的静默建库行为必须消除——远端查询永远不 mkdir；本地 --db 保留原语义但建议 open 前检查（新建库打印提示行）⑤实测：HP 上 --db peerbox:/... 的 task list 返回 peerbox 真实行数（当前 2 行 in_progress）；远端 host 不可达→一行错误退出非空结果；写命令报错指向正路。devdoc+单测。文件域：cmd/agent/cli_tasks.go（--db 解析）+internal/tools（DB path helper）。

### t-1788075576

- status: completed | tags: memsync,tasks,db-sync | parent: 
- summary:
gopi run completed — run: elapsed=36m39s

- spec/payload:
扩展 memory_sync.go（M4 memsync，brew 行 → task 行）：**export**（peerbox 侧）：gopi memsync --export-tasks --status pending --limit N [--tags filter] --since <ts> → SELECT tasks 行（status/tags/order by priority）→ JSON patch（SyncTaskRow: task_id/summary/payload/tags/source/created_at，不含 claimed_by/heartbeat——执行时状态不导出）；**import**（HP 侧）：gopi memsync --import-tasks patch.json → 每行走本地 taskSubmit 同一写入路径：①payload hash 去重（hash(summary+payload)，已存在 pending/claimed/in_progress 同 hash → skip 报 duped，防双投——nick 定案的去重责任在导入端）②task_id 保留原号（peerbox t-* 号跨节点可追溯——冲突时本地加后缀？No：SQLite 主键 task_id 若冲突则 skip+报 already，终态行 sync 回时用前向迁移）③状态机前向迁移（import 只写 pending；本地行的后续状态由本地执行推进；终态回收走反向 export/import——同一机制双向用）④provenance：tags 强制追加 from-peerbox（导入时决定不信任文件，与 brew 行 node:host 同构）⑤永不 UPDATE 已有行的 summary/payload（keep original data no overwrite——nick 硬约束）：同 task_id 且 status=pending → 只补 tags union。实测：①peerbox export 3 条 pending → HP import → HP task list 可见+hash 重复 import → all duped（幂等）②HP 本地执行完成→反向 export/import→peerbox 行 completed（前向迁移）③brew 行同步不受影响（零回归）。devdoc/memsync-task-extension.md。工作流：主仓分支 feat/memsync-tasks，基于 master f1aff7e。

### t-1788075984
- created: 2026-08-30T07:46:24Z | epoch: 1788075984.0
- status: completed | tags: memsync,tasks,sync-back,db-sync | parent: t-1788075576
- summary:
gopi run completed — run: elapsed=36m29s

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 布置）：HP/peerbox=两个独立开发环境各自积累资产——①HP 本地执行完成的 task 终态 ②HP 本地 LLM 自投的新 bugfix 单（peerbox 没有的行）③git feat 分支等 merge ④brew lesson（M4 已有）。需求=双向 sync 回收 peerbox 真账，**DO NOT drop or overwrite any data**（nick 硬约束）。前置：M4.8（t-1788075576）task 行 export/import 单向版正在实现中——本单是其双向扩展+冲突面处理。设计核心（PA 起草供参考，Bond 自行验证修正）：**资产清单与通道**：a) task 行：HP export 终态行（completed/failed+本地自投新行）→peerbox import——已有行的前向迁移（M4.8 机制）+peerbox 没有的行新 INSERT（provenance from-hp）——自投 bug 单是纯新增无冲突；b) git 分支：push-back 通道已验证（HP git push peerbox feat/*），merge 冲突=标准 git 语义，PA/gopi 处理；c) brew：M4 已有零改动。**冲突面三层分析**：①task 状态冲突（同 id 双方都推进了状态）→前向迁移+终态优先+never backward；②task 内容冲突（同 id 不同 payload——理论不可能：payload 不可变设计，若发生=双侧都改了=bug，保留双方+conflict 标记 tag 求人工裁决）；③git 文本冲突（两节点改同模块）→**预防>解决：模块分区路由**（PA 派工时按 tags=node:hp+module:xxx 选段，两节点专注不同模块降低冲突面——nick 的 controlled risk 思想）。**重 testsuite 防线**（nick：no shortcut）：行为断言=同步幂等（往返不丢行不重复）/冲突不静默（每个冲突必有显式报告行）/never-overwrite 断言（同步前后行内容 hash 不变除非前向迁移）/三资产混合往返 E2E（export→mutate→import→re-export 全链）。实测标准：①HP 模拟自投 2 单+完成 1 单→sync back→peerbox 新增 2 行+1 行前向迁移+零数据丢失②双侧同 id 状态推进→import 显式报告冲突决策③模块分区选段导出（--tags module:x 只出该段）④全链幂等往返。工作流：M4.8 merge 后同窗口或紧随（feat/memsync-tasks 分支延续或新分支），devdoc/memsync-bidirectional.md。

### t-1788077827
- created: 2026-08-30T08:17:07Z | epoch: 1788077827.0
- status: completed | tags: bug031,ingest,atomic,db-sync | parent: 
- summary:
[bug031] ingest toggle 非原子：check-then-write 竞态窗口（nick 指出 toggle 必须 atomic）

- spec/payload:
发现（nick：toggle must be precautious to check first and toggle second, ideally atomic）：taskingest.go 的镜像写路径=SELECT 读旧状态（行 137 附近）→应用层判断前向迁移合法性→UPDATE tasks SET status=... WHERE task_id=?（行 156，**无 status WHERE 守卫**）——check 与 write 之间存在竞态窗口：peerbox serve 可能在窗口内 claim/本地推进该行，ingest 的 UPDATE 会无条件覆盖（比如 serve 刚 claim→in_progress，远端 completed 事件到达→覆盖为 completed 但 claimed_by 残留；或本地 failed 后远端 completed 覆盖丢失失败事实）。对照：本地 TaskNext 的 claim 是正确示范（UPDATE ... WHERE task_id=? AND status=pending——CAS 恰一赢家 tasks.go:1900）。修复：ingest 的 UPDATE 加前向迁移守卫——WHERE task_id=? AND status IN (允许的来源状态集)（由 p.Status 与当前态共同决定，或简化为 AND status NOT IN (completed,failed,cancelled,verified) 终态保护）；UPDATE 影响行数=0 时重读当前状态→报 conflict + 当前态（显式报告不静默）。同时审查本地 TaskUpdate（tasks.go:1291）是否也需 CAS（CLI 路径单人操作风险低，可后置）。实测：①并发模拟——线程 A claim 同一行的同时线程 B ingest completed→恰一赢家+另一者收到 conflict 报告②幂等重投递行为不回退（redelivery 仍 no-op）③单测 CAS 竞态。devdoc 记录。文件域 internal/tools/taskingest.go（小）。

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 三问：FIFO/FILO? latest 饿死 oldest? vcmi 跨项目任务无 repo 无优先级?）：诊断=①TaskNextFiltered 领取顺序设计意图 oldest-first 但 SELECT **无 ORDER BY**（依赖 SQLite rowid 隐式序=FIFO 实践成立但语义无保证）②list 显示=created_at DESC（显示倒序是设计非执行序——人看最新）③vcmi bug 单（t-1788062477 source=llm）无 repo 字段——serve 领取后会在 gopi 目录找 vcmi 文件=跨项目灾难；且与主线任务同权重。修复：①TaskNextFiltered 的 sel 加 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC（显式 FIFO 锁死——不依赖隐式行为，注释写明设计意图）②tasks 表加 priority INTEGER DEFAULT 5 列（0 最高——或语义化 high/normal/low；submit --priority flag+task_submit 工具参数+TaskNextFiltered ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at ASC——优先级相同时 FIFO）③deliverable repo 检查前移：TaskStart/serve 领取时若 payload 无 repo 且 summary 提到非 gopi 路径→警告（vcmi 类灾难预防——完整 deliverable 结构化是 M4.9 后续，此处先做护栏）。存量 vcmi 单处置：cancel（跨项目且无 repo——修复应在 vcmi 仓的台账里）。实测：①10 条乱序 pending→next 依次领=created_at 升序②priority=1 任务插队成功③vcmi 类无 repo 单被警告/拒领。devdoc。文件域 tasks.go+cli_tasks.go+loop.go（task_submit 工具描述）。

WHERE task_id=? AND status IN ('pending','claimed')——影响行数=0 → 返回失败（行已被别人领走/不存在/终态）→runTaskRun 收到失败**立即 abort 不执行 briefing**（错误信息含当前实际状态）。TaskResumeClaimed 的 CAS 已对（WHERE status=claimed）保持。实测：①双进程同时 run 同一 pending id→恰一成功另一收到 conflict+abort②行处于 completed→run 报拒绝③正常单跑通。文件域 tasks.go TaskStart（小）。与 TaskUpdate 的 CAS 化（bug031 遗留，CLI 路径）同域可一并评估——至少 TaskStart 这条执行入口必须先 CAS。

### t-1788121946
- created: 2026-08-30T20:32:26Z | epoch: 1788121946.0
- status: cancelled | tags: bug036,error-handling,retry,glm | parent: 
- summary:
[bug036] LLM 错误处理逻辑审查：错误分类矩阵 + 单次错误即全 session 死的 loophole（nick 四问）

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 四问：①1214 为什么 2.4h 后才发生（第一天就该错）②LLM 返回错误=整个 session 失败还是容忍为 toolcall 失败？③网络临时 down 的处理（exponential retry with fixed times?）④非网络未知错误该 handle 什么——ask gopi to inspect error handle loop code to see what is loophole）。现状代码考古：①retry.go：MaxRetries=3+指数 backoff（1s→30s cap+jitter）+retryableStatus=429||>=500+isNetworkError（timeout/DNS/refused/reset）——**网络类和 5xx 有重试**②**400（含 1214/1210）不在 retryable → 零重试 → stream error 直接 return → runEngine 失败 → session failed**——单次确定性错误杀死 2.4h session（loop.go:2657）③四问回答与 loophole：Q1 为什么 2.4h 后才 1214——**嫌疑=中途状态变化**（长会话 compact 后 messages 形态/effort 路径变化），不是参数第一天就错——需要 dead session 请求体重建定位（raw log 无 HTTP 状态记录=观测缺口）；Q2 当前逻辑=LLM 错误即全 session 死（无 per-call 容忍/无降级继续）——**loophole：确定性错误（400 参数错）与瞬时错误（网络/5xx）不分，前者重试无意义但后者该重试——而当前逻辑一刀切**；Q3 网络临时 down=有 exponential retry（1s/2s/4s→30s cap，3 次）✅；Q4 非网络未知错误（400 族）=当前直接死，**应该的分类处理**：400 参数错→重试无意义（确定性）但**值得一次降级重发**（strip 可疑参数如 reasoning_effort/thinking 后重试一次——自我修复式降级）+错误上下文持久化（死前最后请求体落盘=诊断原料）④审查范围（派 Bond 系统过）：a) retry.go 错误分类矩阵（network/429/5xx/4xx/其它——每类策略：retry/degrade-retry/fail-fast+落盘）b) loop.go stream error 的 session 级 vs call 级容忍边界（什么错误该 fail session 什么该 skip turn 继续）c) 死前请求体观测（raw log 加 HTTP 状态/错误体记录——观测缺口修复）d) 1214 特案：GLM 1214=messages 参数非法→自动 strip+重发一次的降级实验 e) 与 resume 的接线：failed session 的标准恢复路径（resume 补全）文档化。实测：模拟 400 错误→降级重发路径走通/模拟网络断→重试 3 次后失败+落盘/死 session 的最后请求体可在磁盘找到。devdoc/error-handling-matrix.md。



<!--row: t-1788122646-->
### t-1788122646
- created: 2026-08-30T20:44:06Z | epoch: 1788122646.0
- status: completed | tags: bug036,error-handling,provider-neutral | parent: 
- summary:
[bug036 v2] LLM 错误处理：provider-neutral 错误分类矩阵 + 最小核降级重发（覆盖 v1 的 vendor-specific 设计）

- spec/payload:
修正（nick 警告 over-handling：code must handle DeepSeek or any other provider——**禁止 vendor-specific 优化**）：v1 设计（t-1788121946）的'1214 特案 strip reasoning_effort'是 vendor-tunnel-vision——作废。**provider-neutral 重设计**：①错误分类矩阵按 HTTP 语义分类（非 vendor 错误码）：4xx=确定性错误（降级重发一次→仍 4xx→fail-fast+请求体落盘）/5xx+429=瞬时（retry×3 指数 backoff——已有）/网络错误=retry（已有 isNetworkError）②**最小核降级**：任何 4xx 的降级重发=剥掉全部 optional/extension 参数（thinking/reasoning_effort/cache_control/top_p/temperature 等非核心字段全 strip）只留 model+messages+max_tokens+stream 最小核——最小核是所有 LLM API 的最大公约数，对 DeepSeek 400 空 thinking 家族/Anthropic 400/GLM 1214 同样生效——一次实现覆盖所有 provider ③禁止 vendor 分支：isGLMModel 的 1210 防护是历史例外，新代码禁止 if glm/if deepseek 分支（vendor 差异进配置数据不进 if 逻辑——如果要维护 per-provider 值域表，做成 config 数据驱动）④死前请求体落盘=通用观测（raw log 补 HTTP 状态+错误响应体——provider-agnostic 诊断原料）⑤session 级 vs call 级容忍边界：4xx 降级失败后 fail session 但**台账留 resume 指引**（failed→resume 是标准恢复路径）| 实测：模拟 DeepSeek 400 空 thinking（历史案）/GLM 1214/Anthropic 400 各跑一次降级路径→全走通最小核重发；模拟网络断→retry 3 次后 fail+落盘；矩阵单测全覆盖。文件域 retry.go+claude_client.go+loop.go。devdoc/error-handling-matrix.md（含 provider-neutral 设计原则）。

背景（nick 两指令）：①bug036 v2 的 per-provider 差异必须进 config 文件非 if-else 逻辑——**落点=复用 settings.json symlink 切换机制**（现状：~/.gopi/settings.json → .glm_settings.json symlink；切到 DeepSeek=ln -sf .deepseek_settings.json settings.json——整个文件切换=全部 vendor 参数一次性变）②参照 hermes 先例：~/.hermes/config-glm.yaml/config-deepseek.yaml symlink 切换已工作。实现：①settings.json schema 扩展 provider 段：现有平铺 keys（api_key/base_url/model/vision_model/reasoning_effort/thinking_budget）+新增 **vendor_quirks 段**（可选，缺省空）：{"vendor_quirks": {"thinking_disabled_supported": false, "reasoning_effort_values": ["max","high","low"], "error_code_map": {"1214": "param_invalid", "1210": "thinking_disabled_rejected"}}}——各 vendor 文件（.glm_settings.json/.deepseek_settings.json）各自携带自己的 quirks；代码读 quirks 数据做判断（error-classify/参数过滤/重试策略）——**数据驱动非 if-else**（bug036 v2 的最小核降级为默认通用策略，quirks 提供例外覆盖）②symlink 切换语义文档化：切 provider=切 symlink→settings 全变（key+quirks 一起）——无部分切换的复杂性③hp-unique-maxtokens-work 分支的 max_tokens 可配置化系列（5c2d112..f9a319a）与本单同域——检查是否已进 master 避免重复。实测：①glm settings 带 quirks→1214 被归类 param_invalid→最小核降级触发②deepseek settings 无 quirks→默认通用策略③切 symlink→quirks 随文件变。devdoc。文件域 internal/config/config.go（schema）+internal/deepseek/retry.go+claude_client.go（读 quirks）。

### t-1788124704
- created: 2026-08-30T21:18:24Z | epoch: 1788124704.0
- status: completed | tags: bug037,crash-dump,at-exit,error-handling | parent: 
- summary:
gopi run completed — run: elapsed=42m48s

- spec/payload:
背景（nick：GO error handle 应 dump error details for investigation——像 linux core dump；且必须 toggle task status to error/failed 否则永远收不到 failure 通知）。现状缺口：①session_end 事件只有 elapsed_sec/exit_code/iterations/tokens——**无 error 详情**（死因 1214 的错误体/最后请求/失败轮次位置全不在）→诊断要翻 raw log 手工拼（raw log 又无 HTTP 状态记录——bug036 观测缺口）②进程 panic/kill -9 时 session_end 可能根本不写=面包屑全无。需求实现：①**session_end 扩展 error 块**：final_error{category(网络/5xx/4xx/vendor), http_status, error_body, last_request_digest(model+messages 长度+最后一条 role), failed_iteration, recoverable_hint(能否 resume)}——LLM 错误/stream error/panic recover 全走同一收集路径 ②**crash dump 文件**：session 失败时写 <session-id>.dump.json（与 JSONL 同目录同命名族——agent resume 可读/PA 可查/gopi server 可预检）：完整最后请求体+完整错误响应+上下文（elapsed/iterations/recent tool calls）——命名对齐 session 文件族 ③**task 状态联动**：error exit → FinishSessionTask 钩子写 failed（**含错误摘要进 summary 尾**——notification 管道自然携带 failure 到 PA 订阅端——当前 in_progress 永挂的根因之一就是这条断了）④panic recover：runEngine 的 defer 加 panic recover→写 dump+session_end(error)→再 re-panic（不让 recover 吞掉退出码）⑤at_exit 语义：正常 exit_code=0 的 session_end 不带 error 块（区分正常结束与失败）。实测：①模拟 LLM 400→session_end 含 error 块+dump 文件存在+task 行 failed+notification 到 PA 订阅端②kill -9→下次启动检测到上次无 session_end→补写 crash dump（孤儿 session 检测）③panic 路径 recover 写 dump。devdoc/crash-dump-design.md。文件域 internal/agent/sessionlog.go+loop.go（error 收集）+taskregister.go（failed 联动）。与 bug036（错误分类矩阵）协同：bug036 定分类，本单定落盘与联动。

### t-1788125937
- created: 2026-08-30T21:38:57Z | epoch: 1788125937.0
- status: completed | tags: bug038,harvest,git-push-back | parent: 
- summary:
[bug038] task harvest 缺 git push-back：db-sync 不带代码同步=资产只回了一半（nick：only DB-sync means nothing）

- spec/payload:
背景（nick：harvest 时是否也 push HP 分支回 peerbox？代码 harvest 回 peerbox 后分支该清理；otherwise only DB-sync means nothing——资产=git+db 双域）：现状=task harvest 只同步 task 行（db 域），HP 本地积累的 feat/* 分支（如刚发现 feat/chat-table 的 backfill 修复 c7bbf0f、feat/chat-hermes-cols 空分支）不同步——代码资产掉在 HP。实现（harvest 命令扩展）：①task harvest --peer hp 完成后**自动 git push-back**：HP 本地所有领先 peerbox/master 的分支（git branch --format + rev-list 判定 ahead>0）→逐个 git push peerbox <branch>（已有纪律的自动化）②push 报告并入 harvest 输出（branches_pushed=[feat/chat-table(1c), ...]/push_failed=[...]）③push 成功后 HP 侧分支不自动删（merge 在 peerbox 决策——git 角色不对称；分支清理=另一机制 t-1788086858 b 项）④peerbox 侧 harvest 后自动 fetch 对端新 push 的分支（git fetch nick@<peer-ip>:~/work/GoPi +branch：或者简化=HP push 直接到位 peerbox 的 refs——push 本身就是 fetch 的逆）⑤顺序：git push-back 先于 db sync（deliverable{branch} 引用的分支先到位——与六合一 pass 的先 git 后 db 同理）。实测：HP 造一分支+1 commit→harvest→peerbox 见分支+db 行；重复 harvest 幂等（已 push 的不再推）。文件域 memory_sync_task.go（harvest 函数尾部加 git 步骤）+exec.Command(git)。devdoc 补节。

- summary:
[M4.16] sync 冲突=server 侧无脑 completed（token-free Go 代码一步到位——nick 终稿）

- spec/payload:
背景（nick：db-sync 很简单根本无需等待 git-branch-decision——冲突就无脑简单解决；我的 Phase 2/3/4 复杂化全部作废）。语义定稿：**sync 冲突（双侧修改同一行）→ server 侧直接标 completed（或 resolved——一枚举无所谓），锚点推进，完事**。理由：①任务状态就是 enum 不值得费思量（task update 不许改内容的设计正是防啰嗦——只能改状态这个 enum）②实质解决在 git branch 那边（真正的 deliverable 在 git branch——merge conflict 是 LLM 的工作，与任务标记系统无关）③重跑=发新任务（与冲突裁决无关——新行新生命周期）④phase 一步完成（无需队列/CLI/LLM 辅助/一致性检查——都是过度设计）。实现：**server 侧 delta 协议的应用函数**（memory_sync_session.go 或 sync 会话应用层）加一个分支：双侧 updated_at 冲突（双侧都改过同一行）→ status 直接写 completed（ended_at=now）+tags 追加 sync-resolved+锚点推进——**纯 Go 无 LLM token-free**。client 侧行为：server 的裁决通过下一次 sync 的 pull 自然到达（client 的行被 server 覆盖为 completed——前向迁移语义内）。实测：①模拟双侧修改同一行→server sync→两侧行都是 completed+sync-resolved tag②锚点推进③重跑幂等。文件域 memory_sync_session.go（小 patch）。devdoc 补节（冲突语义定稿）。与既有件关系：M4.13 delta 协议的冲突分支由此单定义（此前 conflict 计数+推迟设计作废）；M4.9 裁决原则简化为这一条；预见③（终态 vs 终态）同规则覆盖。注意：**only server side executes this**（client 侧 sync 收到 server 推来的 completed=正常前向迁移接受——client 不做裁决）。

背景（nick：HP gopi 也应建 worktree 干活，但收尾=check if client→push branch to server→delete worktree→delete branch——这个标准清理链没有代码）。现状实证：HP 的 feat/sync-conflict-completed 交付（41a0623）已被 peerbox merge 但 HP 侧 worktree+分支仍挂着（gopi-sync-conflict worktree 0 dirty——交付完毕无人收尾）；feat/memsync-bidirectional 38 dirty 在写（不能动）。实现（FinishSessionTask 钩子扩展或独立 sweep——放 serve tick 的 HP pass）：**client 收尾四步链**（仅 role=client 或有 sync_to 时执行）：①判定 task completed/failed 终态+worktree clean（dirty>0 跳过——活 Bond 保护）②git push <server> <branch>（bug038 的 push-back 逻辑——幂等 up-to-date 检测复用）③push 成功→git worktree remove <wt> --force ④worktree 移除成功→git branch -d <branch>（-d 自带未合拒绝——双保险：未 push 成功的分支删不掉）⑤全链 fail-soft（每步独立错误报告不炸）⑥master 分支与 hp-unique-maxtokens-work 归档分支豁免（永不清理）。**server 侧对应链**（peerbox pass）：merge 分支→删本地分支→（HP 的分支 refs 在 push 时已到，无需 fetch）——t-1788086858 的 b 项合并进本单。实测：①模拟 client 完成+clean worktree→四步链走通（push+remove+delete）②dirty worktree→跳过③未 push 成功→branch 保留④master/归档分支豁免。文件域 taskregister.go（钩子）或 serve tick pass。devdoc。

- summary:

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 模型 aligned：领取即所有权——claim 后立即 db-sync 推 pending→in_progress 到对端，对端 TaskNextFiltered 看到 in_progress 天然跳过=准原子所有权；节点平等竞争无 server/client 领取特权；pair-compute 封顶；repeat-tolerance 兜底[nick：Honestly I don't care too much about cost of double running, it is the merge conflict that bother me——窗口压到秒级即可]）。实现：①**claim 即广播**：TaskStart 成功后（本地 CAS 赢家）→异步（不阻塞执行）db-push 到 sync_peers 对端——推送内容=该 task 行的最新状态（in_progress+claimed_by+updated_at）——对端 import 走既有 delta 路径（前向迁移语义内接受 pending→in_progress）②**失败语义（nick 简化定案）**：db-push 失败=**abort claim（本地行回 pending 或直接放弃执行）不 retry 不 rollback 复杂化**——诚实表述：abort 后对端可能领走=所有权让渡，本地不跑——比双跑好（merge conflict 是 nick 真正怕的）；fail-soft 差异：如果对端不可达（网络）→可跳过广播直接本地跑（窗口留给 tick 兜底——比 abort 更实用；区分"对端拒绝"与"对端不可达"两种失败）③**CLI 暴露**：db-push 独立动词（gopi task push 或 sync --push-only）——手动可跑/脚本可调/serve tick 可复用三层消费同一原子件 ④serve tick 复用同一函数（tick 的 db-sync 与 claim 广播共享推送代码路径）。实测：①A 领取→对端库 3s 内见 in_progress②对端不可达→本地照常跑（fail-soft）③同秒双 claim 模拟→恰一赢家或 repeat（可接受）④CLI 手动 push 幂等。文件域 tasks.go（TaskStart 尾部）+memory_sync_session.go（push 函数抽取）+cli_tasks.go（CLI）。devdoc 简短。

背景（nick 补充 M4.18 失败语义：if db-sync failure, it should just update local db with task status update to prevent repeat work——对端拒绝（状态冲突=对端已有该行更新状态）时，本地行不能留 pending（会被再次领取=repeat work）。语义定稿：claim 广播被对端拒绝→本地行 cancel+tags+=sync-yielded——所有权已在别处/本地不再竞争；不新增状态枚举（cancel 是现成终态，tags 表达为什么）| 实现：TaskStart 后广播失败分支（对端拒绝场景）加：①本地 TaskUpdate status=cancelled ②tags+=sync-yielded（对端 import 后双侧同貌：对端行=它自己的状态，本侧行=cancelled/sync-yielded——两侧都不再领）③对端不可达场景不变（fail-soft 照常本地跑，窗口留给 tick）| 实测：模拟对端拒绝（同 id 对端 in_progress 更新）→本地 cancelled+sync-yielded→TaskNextFiltered 不再领→对端跑它的——零 repeat | 文件域同 M4.18 主单（同分支连做）。

### t-1788217912

- status: completed | tags: m420,terminal-push,must-succeed,race-condition,urgent | parent: 
- summary:
gopi run completed — run: elapsed=6m5s

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 定稿的双层 sync 架构——2026-09-01 05:45 陈述：**这是最重要的部分，独立工单紧急做**。目的=防 task-level race condition，从源头消灭 merge conflict——conflict 是 LLM 解冲突烧 token 的最难问题。冲突消亡论：起点原子做对后，日常路径=发我的新记录+收你的新记录零冲突；conflict 只属 legacy 或 bug）。实现（一个文件域连做——taskregister.go+memory_sync_task.go）：**①起点保守（TaskStart 成功路径扩展）**：本地 CAS claim 成功后→立即条件推送 in_progress 到 sync_peers（复用 M4.18 delta 原子件）→对端应用（pending→in_progress 前向迁移）；**对端拒绝（状态冲突=对端已有该行更新）→本地 abort 不执行 briefing**（不竞争不重复——nick：if we cannot acquire ownership, we don't run task）+本地行 cancel+tags+=sync-yielded（M4.18 增补语义确认——TaskNextFiltered 不再领）| **②终点 must-succeed（FinishSessionTask 钩子扩展——本单核心新增）**：任务结束（completed/failed）写完本地行后→**必须成功**推送终态到对端——失败**重试 3 次**（指数 backoff 1s/2s/4s）→仍失败**走 GOPI_TASK_NOTIFY 报警管道**（event=terminal-push-failed——异常信号非静默）；设计依据（nick：at end we are a bit aggressive——起点原子已保证唯一 runner，终点推送无干扰，没有理由失败，must be done）| **③冲突重标（语义级）**：syncDeltaServerResolve 的 conflict 触发时**加 warn 日志+notify 事件**（event=legacy-conflict——normal path 不该有 conflict，触发=起点原子失效的 bug 信号要查根因）——M4.16 裁决降级为 legacy 兜底 | 实测：①模拟对端先 claim→本地起点推送被拒→本地 abort+sync-yielded 不跑 briefing ②正常完成→终点推送成功→对端行状态对齐③模拟对端不可达→重试 3 次→报警事件落 notify 管道④legacy 冲突注入→ruling 照常+warn 事件发出。文件域 taskregister.go（FinishSessionTask/TaskStart）+memory_sync_task.go（push 原子件）。devdoc。

nick拍板push forward。A.worker循环命令gopi worker(临时进程非守护):干活→终点must-succeed推终态(M4.20落码)→顺势db-sync(先PULL对端新记录再PUSH本地新记录——git pull-then-push语义)→领下一个(M4.20起点原子拒绝则yield)→无pending退出;并行度=进程数;死=无状态。B.状态生命周期序模型(核心裁决件取代updated_at时钟比较):pending(0)→claimed(1)→in_progress(2)→终态同级(3:completed/failed/cancelled)——sync裁决=把双侧同步到rank更大状态永不倒退;原子更新=SQL WHERE rank比较(UPDATE WHERE statusRank(current)<statusRank(newer)——影响行数0→重读显式报告;与bug035 CAS同源);终态同级=后到覆盖(equal-anchor conflict残余消失);reopened砍除(唯一逆行特例——重发新任务+老任务completed,append-only;reopen CLI若存在改语法糖);legacy冲突=序无法裁决才走(M4.16 ruling+warn=bug信号);时钟退役:anchor留pull窗口用,行内状态合并一律rank。实测:序表单测/双侧模拟前进/倒退拒绝/reopen reissue/worker全链+2worker并行+重启幂等。文件域memory_sync_delta.go+tasks.go(statusRank)+cmd/agent worker CLI。devdoc含序表+裁决表。

### t-1788222180
- created: 2026-09-01T00:23:00Z | epoch: 1788222180.0
- status: completed | tags: m422,remote-lock,two-phase,highest | parent: 
- summary:
gopi run completed — run: elapsed=1h10m40s

- spec/payload:
nick 定稿（最高优先——所有其他任务的基础）：跨节点任务领取=数据库级两阶段锁+事务回滚。三阶段时序：**Phase1 本地锁 acquire**（本地 CAS：UPDATE tasks SET status=claimed WHERE task_id=? AND status=pending——恰一赢家）；**Phase2 远端锁 acquire**（对端同条件 CAS——对端是协议平等参与者非被动镜子：对端也执行 pending→claimed）；**Phase3 双锁齐=双侧都推进 in_progress**（本地 claimed→in_progress+对端 claimed→in_progress——验收不变式：任务领取后本地行=对端行=in_progress，禁止窗口态[本地跑了对端还 pending=M4.18 信息传递模型的裂痕]）→执行 briefing。**任一失败=事务回滚**：已推进的部分 revert（本地 claimed→pending 保留 claimed_by 审计；对端同理）+**ALOHA 式随机退避重试**（0.5-2s 抖动起，连续碰撞指数退避 cap 30s，上限 N=3 轮后仍碰撞→概率上让渡 yield——以太网 CSMA-CD 同构）。**碰撞不变式**（atomic 正确的推论）：我还在 claimed 时对端只可能 claimed（碰撞→退避重试）或 in_progress（对端双锁齐→我回滚让渡）——不存在 undefined 态。**回滚语义修正**（nick 否决 cancel+yielded 永久退出）：失败必须 revert pending 给对方机会也给自己机会——防'双方都抢不到→双方都放弃'死锁（结果导向第一性原理：两边都不跑是最致命失败）。**与 M4.20 关系**：M4.20 的 claim-broadcast（信息传递模型：对端拒绝=abort+cancel+yielded）升级为锁模型（对端执行 CAS+双锁推进+回滚）——memory_sync_claim.go 的 broadcastClaimToPeer 改为远端 CAS 语义+abort 分支改 revert+退避循环。**实测五组**：①正常全链：本地 claimed→对端 claimed→双侧 in_progress→执行→双侧 completed ②碰撞：双方同时 claim→都卡 claimed→退避后恰一赢家③对端已 in_progress（对端双锁齐）→本地回滚让渡④回滚正确性：Phase2 失败→本地 revert pending 无残留⑤死锁防护：连续碰撞 N 轮→退避序列正确+最终让渡或成功。文件域 memory_sync_claim.go（广播→远端 CAS）+cli_tasks.go（abort 分支改回滚+退避）+tasks.go（状态机校验）。devdoc 含时序图+不变式表。**这是最高优先——聚焦跑通为止。**

nick 目标定稿（2026-09-01 12:00）：automatically task processing without interference from PA or user manual intervention——本单=地基验收。两件连做（同一验证闭环）：**A. backfill 迁移脚本**（scripts/backfill-rank.sh 或 go 子命令——幂等可重跑）：存量行按 rank 模型规整——①reopened 状态行→reissue 语义（rework 新行 t-*-r1 append-only+老行标 completed+reason=verify-rejected[若 P2.5 verified/reopened 语义已进 master]或直接 completed+tags=reissued）②终态同级归一（cancelled/failed 语义留 reason 字段或 tags 保留——status 统一序位）③时钟裁决歧义行重算（双侧 equal-anchor 的历史 conflict 行按 rank 表重判）④双侧执行（peerbox+HP 各跑一次）+迁移前后行数守恒断言+零行丢失验证 | **B. worker-mode 首跑**（HP 侧实测——gopi worker 循环的全链首战）：①HP 起 2 个 worker（并行度旋钮首测）②每 worker 全链：领取（本地 CAS+远端锁广播——M4.22 锁模型）→干活（真任务如 devdoc/小修复）→终点 must-succeed 推终态（M4.20）→顺势 db-sync（pull-then-push——M4.21 file-channel）→领下一个（拒绝则 ALOHA 退避重试）→无 pending 退出③验收硬指标：双 worker 并行零 double-run（锁模型实踪）+双侧台账 in_progress/completed 全程一致（双侧 in_progress 不变式）+worker 退出后无残留状态④PA 零干预全程（worker 自续链+无人工 push/merge）| 交付：backfill 脚本+双侧执行记录+worker 首跑 session 证据（双侧台账对账快照）+devdoc（迁移语义表+worker E2E 报告）。实测即验收——HP 是真实环境非沙盒（worker 跑真任务）。

- status: completed | tags: bug048,sync,anchor,blindspot,priority-1,sync-resolved | parent: 
- summary:

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 定性：**common sense——锚点是同步的起始时间线，锚点之前两侧的行必须 identical**——这是 timestamp-delta 协议的自明前提，PA 未预见=失职）。根因（实测 20 vs 17 pending 差异）：delta 窗口=WHERE updated_at>anchor——单侧创建的行若 updated_at 早于对端锚点推进→**永久不在窗口**（除非该行再被 update）——aad7e286（真任务 auto 行）差点成为静默丢失案例 | **实现两件**：①**task diff --peer 对账命令**：双侧 pending/completed 行集合比对（task_id 集合差+同 id 状态差）——列出差异行+计数——**对账是锚点语义的自检**（common sense 的机制化）②**sync --full 全量对账模式**：忽略锚点重推全部行（M4.21 rank 合并天然去重——幂等）——backfill 迁移同款机制复用；serve tick 周期性（每 N 次增量 sync 后自动跑一次 full 对账——参数化 GOPI_SYNC_FULL_EVERY 默认 10）| **锚点语义修正（nick 的 common sense 写进设计）**：锚点=双方一致确认的共同起点——**它的推进前提是'此时刻之前两侧 identical'**——破坏这个前提的推进（如单侧创建行未同步就推进）=协议 bug。长期修法=锚点推进前自动跑一次对账检查（pending 计数比对）——差≠0→锚点不推进+警告（对账优先于增量）| 实测：①diff --peer 列出当前 5 行差异②sync --full 收敛双侧 pending 集合③锚点推进守卫（人为制造单侧行→锚点拒绝推进）④正常路径不退化（增量 sync 幂等）。文件域 memory_sync_task.go（diff/full）+cli_tasks.go（CLI）+sync_state 守卫。devdoc 含锚点语义表（nick：starting timeline 的自明前提）。

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 质疑揭穿：t-1788173679 的 43187s/4804 轮循环——每轮 bash git log -1 + 纯文本'已完成：HEAD xxx'——bug047 的 stuck-net 未触发。根因：stuck.observe(content, len(toolCalls)>0) 的语义=**tool 轮重置 streak**——监控循环每轮都有 tool_use（查 HEAD）→streak 永远归零→永不 terminate。这是与'纯文本循环'不同的第二类 stuck：**同形 tool_use 循环**（同 tool+同参数+同文本响应的重复）。实现（loop.go 的 stuckState 扩展）：①新增第二计数器：toolStreak——连续 N 轮（同 5）的 tool_use **同 name+同参数签名**（input 的规范化 hash）且文本响应近似（同前缀 50 字符）→也 terminate+notify（event=loop-stuck-toolful，区分两类）②白名单/重置条件：参数变化（真实查询不同目标）或文本变化→重置（真工作不误伤——迭代开发的 bash 每轮参数应不同；同参数同文本=无信息增益循环）③wallclock cap 不变（8h 兜底仍在）④实测：a) mock 同 tool 同参数循环 5 轮→terminate+loop-stuck-toolful b) 参数渐变的正常工作不误伤 c) 两类 stuck 独立计数互不干扰。文件域 loop.go stuckState+notify。devdoc 引用 t-1788173679 二次事故（4804 轮/56 亿 prompt tokens）。

### t-1788260677

- status: completed | tags: bug052,dispatch,db-sync-first,priority-1,sync-resolved | parent: 
- summary:
[bug052] dispatch 前缺 db-sync：serve claim 行后 ssh 远端 task run，但行从未同步到 peer 的 db → 远端 no task with task_id（dispatch 静默失败）

- spec/payload:
背景（nick 2026-09-01 早已预言：'should we call db-sync before gopi actually try to acquire local and remote claimed status?'——serve --once 实测 dispatch t-1788260077 → hp 后 HP 端 no task with task_id 实锤：peerbox 台账有行（1）/HP 台账无（0）——serve 的 dispatch 只 claim 本地行+ssh hp 跑 nohup task run，但**行从未到达 HP 的 db**，远端 gopi 查自己库查无此行→静默失败（nohup >/dev/null 2>&1 把错误吞了）。**证据链**：cmd/agent/dispatch.go 的 dispatchToNode()（150-185 行）=dispatchRemoteCommand（nohup gopi task run <id> --report-to peerbox --repo ...）→dispatchSSHFunc（ssh 发送）→TaskUpdate(in_progress)——**全路径无 SyncTaskSession/db-push 调用**。**修复设计（nick 的 db-sync-first 原则落地）**：①dispatchToNode 在 ssh 腿**之前**先做定向 db-push（复用 SyncTaskExportDelta(Peer=node)+对端 memsync --import——把该任务行（含 payload）推到 peer 的 db）②推送成功（对端确认行存在）才发 nohup task run③失败→不 dispatch（报错+行回 pending——不能派一个 peer 看不见的任务）④nohup 的 >/dev/null 2>&1 改为落盘到对端日志（~/.gopi/dispatch-<id>.log——静默失败不可再犯）⑤实测：a) serve dispatch 一个新任务→HP 库有行+task run 正常启动 b) 对端不可达→不 dispatch+行回 pending c) 重复 dispatch 幂等。文件域 cmd/agent/dispatch.go+internal/tools/memory_sync_task.go（定向单行 export/import 原子件——若 M4.8 的 memsync 已有则复用）。devdoc 引用 nick 预言（2026-09-01 16:30 单侧行锁死同族——db-sync-first 是同一原则的 dispatch 面）。

### t-1788276451
- created: 2026-09-01T15:27:31Z | epoch: 1788276451.0
- status: completed | tags:  | parent: 
- summary:
gopi needs a task merge cli interface

- spec/payload:
currrently gopi has this complex command:

gopi task audit-merges [--repo PATH] [--db PATH] [--submit]
      Branch-backlog audit (foresee-review): inventory the local branches of
      --repo (default cwd; master/main excluded) and report each branch's
      merge posture — ahead count (commits master..<branch>), tip, date.
      REPORT-ONLY by default (no ledger writes). --submit enqueues one
      pending "merge <branch> into master" task per unmerged, not-yet-
      covered branch (dedup keyed branch+tip: a live row or a terminal row
      stamped with the same tip suppresses the duplicate; a branch that
      gained NEW commits after its merge-task closed re-enters the queue).
      The serve daemon runs the same audit every pass, throttled to
      GOPI_MERGE_AUDIT_INTERVAL seconds (default 900; negative disables).


what we really want is not gopi submit a task to do one simple git merge, because most cases, there is no merge conflicts at all. so, why do we want to submit a task to do a one line command? if merge conflicts do occur, that is still gopi work to resolve conflicts by help of LLM. so, this cli should be simple as:
gopi task merge [--repo PATH] [--db PATH] [--branch BRANCH] 
by default, gopi should just try to quickly merge all branches one by one, and if no branch is given. and resolve conflicts one by one. (another possible optimization is try to merge quickly as many as possible. and leave all conflicting branches to LLM to solve)
this feature is used for "gopi task serve " and this cli interface expose to help debugging and possibly running manually. so, you are supposed to retire original "audit-merges" part and develop a new simple interface to handle all merge functions

A. loop.go 加 toolStreak 第二计数器：连续 N=10 轮满足（同 tool 名 + 同参数规范化 hash + 文本近似）→ terminate + notify event=loop-stuck-toolful。参数规范化：bash 取 command 字段 hash；input JSON 序列化后 hash。

C. 阈值考虑监控场景：sleep 115 意味着 10 轮 ≈ 20 分钟——合理的"等待上限"。可 env 覆盖（GOPI_STUCK_TOOLFUL_ROUNDS）。
D. 测试：mock LLM 连续 10 轮返回相同 bash tool_use → terminate；参数变化的 tool_use 不触发。

## Symptom
gopi task run t-1788305178 (code-review of the config/options layer) claimed at 07:37:28 (claimed_by peerbox:913343) and FAILED at 07:37:47 with:
  result: gopi run failed: signal: broken pipe — run: elapsed=18s
This is the FIRST run of the task — it failed almost immediately. A resubmitted twin (same briefing) may fail the same way, so the root cause must be found.

## Evidence (gathered 2026-09-02, all read-only)
1. Executor session: /home/user/.gopi/sessions/4d410346-248e-46ae-ac7f-be26b67897b8.jsonl — contains ONLY the session_start line (model=deepseek-v4-flash, rawLogPath=/home/user/.gopi/raw/gopi-raw-20260902-073729.log, workdir=/home/user/workspace/gopi-review-task-sync, timestamp 07:37:29). No message/tool events ever landed → the child died between session registration and the first response processing.
2. Raw log /home/user/.gopi/raw/gopi-raw-20260902-073729.log is 323KB and its tail shows a FULLY BUILT first API request body (complete tool schemas incl. vision_analyze/text2img, thinking.type=enabled, budget_tokens=8192, reasoning_effort=high) → request construction was healthy; death happened while writing to the response pipe.
3. workdir anomaly: the child ran in /home/user/workspace/gopi-review-task-sync — the worktree for review/cli-task-sync — even though the task is the config/options review whose briefing says to use the existing worktree (gopi-review-cli-config / review/cli-config-options exists in `git worktree list`). Worktree selection is suspect (who picked it and how?).
4. Concurrency: at the same time (07:39) another task run t-1788305211 (gopi log review, process 913796) was running in parallel. Both run through the same task-run wrapper path.
5. The claimer 913343 is gone now (checked 08:0x) — no surviving process to inspect; the wrapper observed the child's SIGPIPE and wrote the failure back.

## Investigation directions (in order)
1. cmd/agent/cli_tasks.go runTaskRun (and the task-run wrapper): how is the child's stdout/stderr piped? What closes the pipe read-end? Is there a window where the wrapper exits (or is reaped) while the child still writes → SIGPIPE on the child? Check the parent/child lifecycle: does the wrapper wait for the child or can a signal/exit race kill the pipe?
2. Worktree selection: how does the child pick its workdir? The briefing says "if a worktree already has your branch, use it" — but the child landed in the WRONG worktree (gopi-review-task-sync instead of gopi-review-cli-config). Where is that decided (flag/env/settings/cwd)? Is wrong-worktree selection a symptom or a cause of the pipe break?
3. Parallel-task interference: two task runs in the same repo at once — any shared pipe/fd/process-group state in the wrapper that two concurrent runs could corrupt?
4. Reproduce: run `gopi task run` on a trivial new task (submit one with summary "smoke" + tiny payload) and see whether it also dies broken-pipe; if it reproduces, bisect the wrapper path.

## Deliverable
- devdoc/bugfix-broken-pipe-<date>.md: root cause with file:line evidence, fix (if code), regression test (if code), or proof of environmental cause.
- If it's a code bug: fix it (surgical, GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, commit).

### t-1788307190
- created: 2026-09-01T23:59:50Z | epoch: 1788307190.0
- status: completed | tags: feature,memory,sync | parent: 
- summary:
FEATURE: gopi memory sync --peer — cross-node memory-asset sync (unique-only, low-hanging-fruit)

- spec/payload:
FEATURE: cross-node memory-asset sync — `gopi memory sync --peer <alias>` (unique-only, low-hanging-fruit).

## Background (nick 2026-09-02)
The db-sync story so far covers ONLY the task ledger (gopi task sync --peer, M4.13 timestamp-delta). A big part of memory.db was missed: the MEMORY ASSETS written by `memory_store` (distilled_qa rows — the knowledge base that memory_search reads, plus the M4.10 procedural rows). These are assets, not queue state: peerbox and HP each accumulate their own brew/lesson rows, and neither side can retrieve the other's — a gap exactly parallel to the task-ledger gap that db-sync closed.

GOAL: a gopi CLI verb that pushes/pulls the UNIQUE memory records between peerbox and HP so both sides share a superset. NO conflict resolution — conflicts are totally complicated and deliberately OUT OF SCOPE. Just the low-hanging fruit: rows that exist on one side only get copied to the other.

## Existing pieces to REUSE (do not reinvent — grep before writing)
1. `gopi memsync --export/--import [--export-proc/--import-proc]` (cmd/agent/cli_memsync.go + internal/tools/memory_sync.go, memory_sync_procedural.go, memory_sync_session.go): git-PR semantics, JSON patch file travel, import goes through MemoryStore (dedup exact+similarity, sources union, provenance `sources=node:<exporting-node>`, idempotent re-import no-op). This is the underlying atomic apply-path — keep it.
2. `gopi task sync --peer ALIAS` (internal/tools/memory_sync_delta.go + cli): M4.13 bidirectional timestamp-delta over ssh with whitelisted peers (settings.json `sync_peers` / GOPI_SYNC_PEERS — ssh aliases), newer-updated_at wins, terminal never regresses, equal-anchor difference tagged conflict. This is the SHAPE template for the new verb (ssh direct, peer whitelist, no file travel).
3. anti-reflow / provenance guards: rows tagged `from-<peer>` must never be re-exported back (M4.13 syncSelfTag logic, memory_sync_delta.go) — reuse for the memory channel.
4. MemoryStore write path: internal/tools/memory.go — exact-dedup on question, trigram similarity screen, FTS triggers fire on INSERT (distilled_qa_ai / _tri_ai).

## Design (nick's framing, keep it simple)
- NEW CLI verb (naming: `gopi memory sync --peer <alias>` — or `gopi memsync --peer <alias>` direct mode; implementer picks the cleaner fit, but the surface must be ONE verb with --peer, help text, and stats output).
- SYNC SEMANTICS = unique-only superset merge:
  - PUSH direction (local → peer): SELECT rows that the PEER does not have (identity = question, the MemoryStore exact-dedup probe) → send to peer → peer applies via its own MemoryStore path (dedup, provenance node:<sender>, FTS fires).
  - PULL direction (peer → local): symmetric — rows the LOCAL does not have, imported through the LOCAL MemoryStore path.
  - One invocation does BOTH directions (bidirectional, like task sync --peer) OR --push/--pull flags; implementer picks, but bidirectional-one-shot is the default so a single `gopi memory sync --peer hp` from either side converges both.
  - UNIQUE determination is deliberately CONSERVATIVE: exact question match is the identity probe. Rows that exist on BOTH sides (same question) are NEVER touched regardless of content divergence — that is the "conflict" zone and is out of scope by design. (Do not try to merge divergent copies; do not pick newer wins; do not tag conflicts. Skip and count them as `skipped-existing`.)
  - Scope: distilled_qa (brew/knowledge rows) as the primary channel; procedural rows (M4.10, memory_sync_procedural.go) IF the existing export-proc/import-proc path makes it near-free — otherwise mark procedural as follow-up in the devdoc and do NOT stretch this task.
- TRANSPORT: ssh direct to the peer alias (settings sync_peers whitelist; reuse task sync's ssh exchange plumbing if separable — memory_sync_claim_ssh.go has the ssh pattern). No file travel, no intermediate patch files in the happy path.
- IDEMPOTENT: re-running after convergence reports ~0 imported (like task sync's "already N").
- SAFETY: never overwrite/update existing local rows (insert-only); provenance `node:<peer>` on everything imported; anti-reflow so imported rows are not re-pushed back in the opposite direction.
- Stats output: imported / duped-skipped / existing-skipped per direction, like task sync's tally.

## Deliverable (mandatory, full package)
- CLI: the verb with --help text (self-documented, Rule: every subcommand documents itself), flags (--peer required, --db optional, maybe --dry-run for the first real run), exit codes, stats output.
- Tests: unit tests (dual in-memory/temp-db simulation of two MemoryStores: unique rows flow both ways, existing rows skipped, idempotent second run, anti-reflow verified, provenance tags correct) + at least one E2E against two real temp databases or two nodes if cheap (look at memory_sync_bidir2_e2e_test.go for the established pattern; TestBidir2DivergentTerminalsConverge shows the harness).
- Docs: devdoc/memory-sync-assets-<date>.md — design, command usage, semantics table (what syncs / what is skipped as conflict / what is out of scope), the reuse map (which existing pieces), and the known-limitation note that divergent same-question rows are intentionally not reconciled.
- GOPI.md touch if the verb belongs in a documented command family (check first; add one line if a command list exists).
- Follow GOPI.md: no magic numbers, build+test green before commit, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (check `git worktree list` first — reuse a review/... worktree ONLY if unrelated; otherwise create e.g. feat/memory-assets-sync), commit to main repo (worktree = shared, no push needed).
- FINAL message MUST declare: (1) branch name, (2) recovery command (`git show <branch>:devdoc/memory-sync-assets-<date>.md`), (3) confirmation the commit is in the main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. `gopi memory sync -h` shows the verb, flags, semantics.
2. Two-store simulation: A has rows {1,2}, B has {2,3} → after sync both have {1,2,3}; row 2 (divergent or identical) untouched; second sync imports 0.
3. Anti-reflow: rows imported from B into A are not re-pushed to B.
4. Provenance: imported rows carry node:<peer> in sources.
5. Full go test suite green (at least internal/tools + cmd/agent).
6. devdoc written and committed.

Repo: ~/work/GoPi. If anything in this design conflicts with an existing mechanism you find while reading, resolve in favor of the EXISTING mechanism and note it in the devdoc — this is an evolution of M4 memsync + M4.13 task sync, not a third parallel design.

BUG FIX: `gopi worker -h` runs the worker loop (live side-effect on -h) — P0-1 from devdoc/review-cli-task-sync.md.

## The bug
cmd/agent/main.go:25 `isWorkerSubcommand` checks only `args[0] == "worker"` and calls `runTaskWorker()` — NO `-h`/`--help` scan, no flag parsing. `gopi worker -h` therefore STARTS A REAL WORKER: it claims and executes a live pending task. `-h` must NEVER have side-effects.

## Live incidents (both real, both this bug)
1. 2026-09-02 07:37 — the task-sync review Bond ran `gopi worker -h` to capture its usage head; it claimed t-1788305178 (sibling config/options review task), spawned a nested gopi, the bash timeout killed the loop → row left `failed` with result "signal: broken pipe — elapsed=18s". (Review report's own Incident log.)
2. 2026-09-02 07:51 — PA ran `gopi worker -h` the same way; it claimed t-1788305179 (memory family review) → failed 6s "broken pipe". Same root cause.
Both failures looked like "task-run wrapper broken pipe" but were actually worker -h side-effects. This is the class of bug the epic's isXSubcommand registry review hunts: every other subcommand handles -h correctly; worker is the sole offender.

## Fix (as specified in the review report)
1. `isWorkerSubcommand` (or the worker dispatch path) must scan argv for `-h`/`--help` BEFORE running the loop and print a usage head + exit 0.
2. Add a `workerUsageHead` named constant (Rule 1) describing: the loop contract (claim → run → must-succeed push → db-sync → next; exit on drained queue), `GOPI_WORKER_MAX_ROUNDS`, and the pa-queue exclusion (--skip-tag semantics if applicable).
3. Regression test `TestWorkerHelpDoesNotRun`: with a pending task queued, `gopi worker -h` must print help and claim NOTHING.

## Deliverable
- Surgical fix + named constant + regression test.
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (check `git worktree list` first — do NOT touch review/* branches; create e.g. feat/fix-worker-help), commit to main repo (worktree = shared).

2. TestWorkerHelpDoesNotRun passes.

BUG FIX: gopi log subcommand P1 batch — rune-safe truncation, FindSession ambiguity, corruption/partial-session consistency. From devdoc/review-cli-log.md (the log review, 2026-09-02).

## The bugs (all P1, all verified with synthetic CJK/corrupt sessions)
1. **Byte-vs-rune truncation (5 sites)**: display truncations slice UTF-8 mid-rune producing U+FFFD replacement chars in output. Sites include `combined[:500]` thinking-block truncation (view --chat), and others in the view renderers. Proven with synthetic CJK sessions.
2. **FindSession bare prefix-match hazard**: the short-ID prefix match silently selects an ARBITRARY file when the prefix is not unique — 13 real sessions share 4-char prefixes today. Live `--last` output also shows truncated session IDs in the summary line.
3. **Inconsistent corruption/partial-session handling**: one corrupt file kills `--last N --view` (error path aborts), while the summary path skips it gracefully; `--last` ordering is mtime-based (flip-flops while sessions are being written); `--json` prints the raw file even when empty / lacking session_start.

## Fix (as specified in the review report's suggested fix order)
1. Rune-safe truncation helper + replace the 5 byte-cut sites (use utf8.RuneStart / rune-counting, not byte slicing).
2. FindSession ambiguity → error with candidate list instead of silently picking one.
3. renderSessionView error path → continue (align with the summary path's graceful skip).
4. ListSessionFiles sort by session_start timestamp (not mtime flip-flop).
5. (If cheap) --json: refuse empty / no-session_start files with a clear error.

### t-1788307649
- created: 2026-09-02T00:07:29Z | epoch: 1788307649.0
- status: completed | tags: bug,cli,security | parent: 
- summary:
BUG: --home X does not redirect settings.json read — sandbox leaks production api_key (P0-1 config review)

- spec/payload:
BUG FIX: `--home X` does NOT redirect the settings.json read — data-root isolation silently leaks production credentials (P0-1 from devdoc/review-cli-config-options.md, review/cli-config-options branch).

## The bug (SECURITY / ISOLATION — P0)
`--home X` is documented as "redirects sessions, raw logs, memory.db and settings away from the profile" — but the settings read is NOT redirected. main.go resolves the settings path BEFORE ApplyEnv injects GOPI_HOME into the env:

```go
settingsPath := overrides.SettingsPath          // --settings flag only
if settingsPath == "" {
    settingsPath = deepseek.SettingsPath()      // ← GOPI_SETTINGS env + GopiDir()
}
base, sErr := config.FromSettingsFile(settingsPath)
config.ApplyEnv(base, false)                    // GOPI_HOME injected HERE
config.ApplyEnv(overrides, true)
```

`deepseek.SettingsPath()` resolves the default via `config.GopiDir()` which reads GOPI_HOME **from the process env** — the `--home` flag value only lands in the env AFTER this call. So `--home X` reads `~/.gopi/settings.json` (real api_key / model / compute_nodes) instead of `X/.gopi/settings.json`. Sessions/raw-logs/memory.db ARE redirected (they resolve via GopiDir() at use time) — settings are not.

Impact: the flagship sandbox-isolation knob silently leaks the REAL profile's settings (api_key, model, compute_nodes topology) into a sandboxed run (test suite, CI, A/B experiment). The GOPI_HOME env form works; the flag form does not. Empirically confirmed with a SANDBOX-MODEL-MARKER probe.

## Fix (as specified in the report)
Resolve the settings path AFTER applying GOPI_HOME, or inject the flag's GopiHomePath into the env (or into deepseek.SettingsPath()'s resolution) BEFORE the settings read. One-line reorder in cmd/agent/main.go + a regression test:
- Regression test: `--home <sandbox>` with a marker {"model":"SANDBOX-MODEL-MARKER"} in sandbox settings must pick up the marker (currently picks up real ~/.gopi/settings.json); GOPI_HOME env form keeps working.

## Deliverable
- Surgical fix + regression test.
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (do NOT touch review/* branches; e.g. feat/fix-home-settings-isolation), commit to main repo.
- devdoc/bugfix-home-settings-<date>.md.
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. `--home <sandbox>` picks up sandbox settings (marker probe) — isolation real.
2. GOPI_HOME env form still works.
3. `go test ./internal/config/ ./cmd/agent/` green.
4. devdoc committed.

Repo: ~/work/GoPi. Reference report: `git show review/cli-config-options:devdoc/review-cli-config-options.md`.

### t-1788308475
- created: 2026-09-02T00:21:15Z | epoch: 1788308475.0
- status: completed | tags: bug,cli | parent: 
- summary:
BUG: task run <id> double-executes already-running task — TaskClaimExplicit ignores RowsAffected (P0 task-core review)

- spec/payload:
BUG FIX: `task run <id>` double-executes an ALREADY-RUNNING task — TaskClaimExplicit shape ② ignores RowsAffected (P0 from devdoc/review-cli-task-core.md, review/cli-task-core branch).

## The bug (P0 — data-integrity / concurrent-execution hazard, E2E-proven)
`TaskClaimExplicit` (the explicit-task-id claim path behind `task run <id>`) has two shapes; shape ② ignores the RowsAffected return of its conditional UPDATE. Running `gopi task run <id>` against a task that is ALREADY in_progress (or claimed) therefore proceeds to execute it a SECOND time instead of refusing — double execution of the same task, both runners writing the same deliverable. E2E-proven in the review (see devdoc/review-cli-task-core.md for the reproduction).

This is exactly the class of hazard the M4.21/4.22 claim-lock protocol was built to prevent — the explicit-id path bypasses it. Note the contrast: `task run next` (TaskNextFiltered) does the CAS correctly; the explicit-id path does not check its own write.

## Fix
- `TaskClaimExplicit` shape ②: check RowsAffected; when 0 (row not in a claimable state — already in_progress/claimed by someone/terminal), REFUSE with a clear error naming the current status and holder (like the M4.5 "already live-claimed locally" refusal), and do NOT run the briefing.
- Keep crash-recovery semantics: `task run <id>` on a `claimed` row whose holder is dead is the legitimate resume path — so distinguish "claimed by a live process" vs "claimed by a dead process" (or keep the existing resume semantics and only hard-refuse in_progress + terminal). Match the review's exact finding — read devdoc/review-cli-task-core.md first.
- Regression test: `task run <id>` on an in_progress row must refuse and exit non-zero without executing; `task run next` behavior unchanged.

## Deliverable
- Surgical fix + regression test.
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (do NOT touch review/* branches; e.g. feat/fix-task-run-double-exec), commit to main repo.
- devdoc/bugfix-task-run-double-exec-<date>.md.
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. `task run <id>` on in_progress → refused, exit non-zero, briefing NOT executed, row untouched.
2. Legitimate resume (claimed + dead holder) still works.
3. `go test ./internal/tools/ ./cmd/agent/` green.
4. devdoc committed.

## The bugs (both P1, both E2E-proven in the review)
1. **Verify briefing instructs a DEAD flag**: the verify-loop briefing (P2.5 verify protocol) tells the child to use `gopi task update --summary <verdict>` — but the CLI `update` command was narrowed to status-only (M4.5: content immutable; --summary removed). The child hits "unknown flag", the verify evidence chain breaks (3 wasted child tool calls observed E2E). Evidence is lost because the verdict can't be written back.
2. **Serve daemon dies on a failed run**: `task serve`'s loop calls `os.Exit(1)` when a run fails — the dispatch/merge-management daemon dies permanently on the FIRST failed task. Same class as the old bug028 (refuse-path os.Exit killing serve). The loop should log the failure, writeback the row, and CONTINUE to the next tick.

## Fix
1. Verify briefing: update the protocol text to the current CLI surface — verdict writeback must use whatever the correct path is today (check: `task verify` CLI? `task update --status verified`? tags? Find the actual mechanism in cli_tasks.go / the verify-loop code and point the briefing at it). If a per-verb `task verify <id> --verdict X` exists, use it; otherwise document the correct status-only sequence. The evidence must land.
2. Serve loop: replace the os.Exit(1) on failed run with a log line + continue. The daemon survives task failures. Add a regression test: a failing task run inside serve --once does not kill the daemon (serve --once exits normally after processing the failed row).

## Deliverable
- Surgical fixes + regression tests for both.
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (do NOT touch review/* branches; e.g. feat/fix-task-p1), commit to main repo.
- devdoc/bugfix-task-p1-<date>.md.
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. Verify child can write its verdict via the documented mechanism (no unknown-flag).
2. A failed task run inside serve does not kill the daemon (serve --once exits normally, next task still processed).
3. `go test ./internal/tools/ ./cmd/agent/` green.
4. devdoc committed.

DEBUG TASK (HP node, 2026-09-02): in_progress zombie rows on HP — why terminal close-out never ran.

## Symptom (observed on HP 2026-09-02 08:2x)
`gopi task list --status in_progress` on HP showed 3 rows with NO live process, NO session file, and updated_at frozen 1h+:
1. 78d40ad1-2150-4b00-9a78-a7bd31933583 (auto row, summary "tash run t-1788304050", created 07:07:44, updated_at frozen 07:07:44) — the session file never existed / was never written.
2. t-1788304050 (mirror of a peerbox task; peerbox side is already terminal failed/cancelled) — HP row stuck in_progress, updated_at 07:23:47.
3. t-1788275530 (LLM-submitted, created 23:12:10 prev day, updated_at 07:16:33).
All three were cancelled manually by PA (08:2x). ps on HP showed ZERO gopi processes — the rows had no living runners.

## Why this matters
in_progress rows are supposed to close out via FinishSessionTask (session_end → writeback completed/failed) or via the stale sweep (serve tick / task run entry). On HP none of that happened — no serve daemon, no worker loop running, and the stale sweep never fires without a serve tick. The rows silently sat for 1h+.

## Investigation directions (in order)
1. HP has no serve daemon and no worker loop — confirm the stale sweep's trigger points on HP (is it serve-tick-only? does `gopi task run` entry sweep HP rows? If HP runs tasks only via one-shot worker loops, what cleans up a crashed worker's rows?).
2. Row 1 (auto, no session file): how does taskregister create an auto row for a session whose JSONL was never written? Can a session die between taskregister and first JSONL write? Check the session-registration ordering (session.go / taskregister.go).
3. Row 2 (mirror): claim-lock broadcast / db-sync mirror rows on HP — when the SOURCE (peerbox) row goes terminal, does the mirror row ever learn? (Only via the next sync; if no sync runs, it stays in_progress forever.) Is there a mechanism to expire mirror rows whose source is terminal elsewhere?
4. Row 3 (LLM-submitted): its session file existed at some point? (Check ~/.gopi/sessions/ history if possible.) Why no writeback on process death (SIGKILL? session_end crash?).
5. Recommend the minimal fix: e.g. (a) stale-sweep trigger on `gopi task list` / `gopi task show` reads (query-side), or (b) a `gopi task sweep-stale` CLI verb that can be run by hand/cron/worker without a serve daemon, or (c) document that HP needs a periodic sweep invocation. Pick the minimal honest fix consistent with the no-service philosophy (nick: "I hate service") — do NOT propose a daemon.

## Deliverable
- devdoc/bugfix-hp-zombie-closeout-<date>.md: root cause per row (file:line evidence), the minimal fix (code if justified, else documented procedure), regression test if code.

### t-1788309830
- created: 2026-09-02T00:43:50Z | epoch: 1788309830.0
- status: failed | tags: bug,cli,resolved | parent: 
- summary:
BUG: stuck-detection false-positives on job_output polling — kills legitimate waiting tasks, blocks single-node loop

- spec/payload:
BUG FIX: stuck-detection (toolStreak, bug055) false-positives on polling/waiting tools — job_output loops kill legitimate tasks. BLOCKS the single-node closed loop.

## Symptom (2026-09-02, three real victims in one morning)
Three tasks were terminated by "agent loop stuck: 10 consecutive rounds with identical tool calls (tool=job_output)":
1. t-1788306421 (broken-pipe debug Bond, 08:19) — died 1885s in, mid-investigation, no deliverable.
2. t-1788307556 (worker -h fix, ~08:4x) — died 448s in, FAIL, and its failure then killed the serve daemon via the os.Exit(1) path (separate bug, t-1788308476).
3. (t-1788307557 also seen failing — same signature.)
All three were legitimately WAITING on a background job via `job_output` (same job id → same tool args every round → identical-tool signature). The toolStreak detector (bug055: same tool + same args hash × N → terminate) cannot distinguish "stuck loop" from "legitimate polling wait". A waiting Bond that polls job_output every round is NOT stuck — the job is running and the Bond is waiting for it; identical args are BY DESIGN for polling tools.

## The design flaw
bug055 was built from the 718319 incident (a monitoring loop `git log` with same args, no progress, no exit condition, 12h). The fix over-generalized: identical-tool+args is NOT a reliable stuck signal for POLLING tools (job_output, and by extension any wait/poll tool), whose contract is "same args, check progress, return current state". The detector needs a polling-tool exemption.

## Fix direction (implementer chooses the minimal correct one)
1. Add a polling-tool whitelist (job_output, job_start; grep for tools whose contract is "poll/wait/check progress") that EXEMPTS them from toolStreak's identical-args accumulation — a Bond polling job_output is alive by construction (it is waiting for an external state change, which is legitimate and finite).
2. OR change the stuck signal from "same tool+args × N" to "same tool+args × N AND no state change observed in the polled target" (e.g. job_output returns identical output text N times in a row → then it IS stuck; output changing or "still running" with no progress is still waiting). This keeps catching true stuck loops while not killing legitimate waits.
3. Keep the 718319 case protected: a bare `bash git log` monitoring loop with no external-wait semantics must STILL be caught. So the exemption must be narrow: only tools whose semantic contract is polling/waiting — not a general "same tool allowed" relaxation.

## Deliverable
- Fix + regression tests: (a) a Bond polling job_output on a still-running job for 20+ rounds is NOT terminated; (b) the 718319-style bare bash monitoring loop IS still terminated; (c) a job_output poll on a completed/unchanging job for N rounds IS terminated (stuck remains detectable).
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (e.g. feat/fix-stuck-polling-exempt), commit to main repo.
- devdoc/bugfix-stuck-polling-<date>.md.
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. The three regression tests above pass.
2. `go test ./internal/agent/ ./internal/tools/` green (the stuck-net lives in internal/agent/loop.go + tests).
3. devdoc committed.

Repo: ~/work/GoPi. High priority: this is the blocker for the single-node closed loop (tasks die → serve dies → loop broken).

### t-1788327511
- created: 2026-09-02T05:38:31Z | epoch: 1788327511.0
- status: completed | tags: bug,cli | parent: 
- summary:
BUG(cont): broken-pipe guard incomplete — wrapper never exports GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID, child guard dead (test RED)

- spec/payload:
BUG FIX (continuation): broken-pipe SIGPIPE guard incomplete — wrapper never exports GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID so the child-side guard never activates. Test TestTaskRunSurvivesClosedStdoutPipe is RED.

## Context
Bond (t-1788306421, killed by the old stuck-detector before finishing) left a partial fix on branch fix/task-run-broken-pipe, commit d3731cb (4 files, +269):
1. wrapper (cmd/agent/cli_tasks.go runTaskRun): signal.Ignore(syscall.SIGPIPE) before spawn — protects the wrapper's own post-spawn writes.
2. child (cmd/agent/main.go): SIGPIPE ignore gated on GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID env (bug057 seam comment claims "the wrapper exports GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID pre-spawn").
3. Tests (cmd/agent/cli_tasks_test.go TestTaskRunSurvivesClosedStdoutPipe — closes the stdout pipe mid-run, expects exit 0) + devdoc.

## The gap (verified by PA, 2026-09-02)
GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID exists ONLY as a constant (internal/tools/tasks.go:2547 `TaskWrapperEnv = "GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID"`) and in a comment (internal/agent/taskregister.go:121 "the parent exports GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID") — **the wrapper NEVER actually exports it**. grep across all non-test Go files shows no `os.Setenv` / `cmd.Env` write of the variable anywhere. So the child's main.go guard never sees the env → SIGPIPE stays at default disposition in the child → the closed-pipe write still kills it. Test result confirms:
```
--- FAIL: TestTaskRunSurvivesClosedStdoutPipe (2.96s)
    task run exited -1 (want 0 — SIGPIPE death leaves 141); err=signal: broken pipe
```

## Fix
1. In runTaskRun (cmd/agent/cli_tasks.go), when constructing the child's exec.Cmd, export GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID into cmd.Env with a unique value (task id or the wrapper row id — check what taskregister.go:121 expects; the human wrapper row's session/task id is the natural value). Look at how cmd.Env is currently built (or is nil — then build a copy of os.Environ() + the new var).
2. Keep/verify the child-side main.go gate reads the same var name.
3. TestTaskRunSurvivesClosedStdoutPipe must pass: task run with a closed stdout pipe exits 0 (run survives; writeback succeeds).
4. Full regression: go test ./cmd/agent/ (the whole package, not just the new test) + go build.
5. Also verify: top-level `gopi | head` still dies normally on pipe close (SIGPIPE semantics preserved outside task-run); and the claim-lock/broadcast lines the wrapper prints before spawn are also protected (that is what the wrapper-side signal.Ignore covers).

## Deliverable
- Fix on top of fix/task-run-broken-pipe (continue that branch — PA already committed d3731cb there; work in the existing worktree /home/user/workspace/gopi-fix-broken-pipe or a fresh one on the same branch).
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, commit to the branch (main repo shared via worktree).
- Update devdoc/bugfix-broken-pipe-20260902.md with the completed chain (wrapper ignore + child env-gated ignore + the export link that was missing).
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. TestTaskRunSurvivesClosedStdoutPipe GREEN.
2. go test ./cmd/agent/ full package green.
3. go build ok.
4. `gopi | head` (top-level) still exits via SIGPIPE (not ignored outside task-run).
5. devdoc updated.

Repo: ~/work/GoPi. This is the second half of the t-1788305178 broken-pipe root cause (first half = worker -h side effect, t-1788307556). Serve is healthy and stuck-detection is fixed — no more false kills while you work.

- spec/payload:
BUG FIX: serve (server role) merges branches but never cleans up the worktree — branch list frozen forever after merge. nick's finding, 2026-09-02.

## Symptom (nick, 2026-09-02, verified)
All 12 branches are now IN-master (merge-base --is-ancestor confirmed, master tip 5f905bd 13:56:59 — serve's merge-backlog/audit path merged them all). But `git branch` still shows all 12 — EVERY one has a worktree checkout (worktree=1), and nothing removes the worktree after merge. Branch count never decreases; cleanup never finishes. nick: "git branch merged, if you don't remove worktree, the cleanup work is not finished. this is a bug of gopi server".

## Root cause (verified in code)
1. serve tick's merge paths (serveMergeBacklogAudit/executor, adoption ③a) merge the branch into master then attempt `git branch -d <branch>` — but git REFUSES -d for a branch checked out in a worktree ("Cannot delete branch ... checked out at ..."). The code tolerates this as a "reportable wart" (task_adoption.go:234-238: "The merge landed; losing only the ref deletion is a reportable wart") — so the branch AND its worktree stay forever.
2. The mechanism that SHOULD remove worktrees is serveFinishCleanupSweep (cli_tasks.go ~1202-1209) — "terminal rows whose close-out chain never ran get their deliverable handed off here — push → worktree remove → branch -d". BUT it is a CLIENT-ONLY pass ("the server integrates; the client gate inside skips server nodes"). peerbox runs serve as the SERVER role → finish-cleanup is skipped → no worktree removal on the server at all.
3. Result: on the server (peerbox), merged branches + their worktrees accumulate indefinitely. Merge works, cleanup doesn't.

## Fix (implementer picks the minimal correct one)
Add a SERVER-side merged-branch cleanup pass to the serve tick (or extend the existing finish-cleanup sweep with a server-role branch):
- Discover: branches that are IN-master (git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> master == 0) AND still exist as local branches.
- For each, check its worktree (git worktree list): if a worktree checks out the branch, decide SAFE-TO-REMOVE:
  a) worktree is CLEAN (0 dirty files — no uncommitted work),
  b) the branch's corresponding task (auto mirror row task_id=session_id, or the deliverable.branch-matched human row) is TERMINAL (completed/failed/cancelled) — OR there is no task row but the branch tip commit predates the merge (docs/review-only branches: after merge they carry no more work by construction),
  c) no live process is writing in the worktree (session JSONL mtime older than a threshold — reuse the stale threshold pattern; or simpler: worktree HEAD == merged tip AND clean AND task terminal).
- If safe: `git worktree remove <path>` then `git branch -d <branch>`. Fail-soft per branch (log + continue), like the other sweeps.
- If NOT safe (dirty / task in_progress / active session): skip, log — a live Bond must never be disturbed.
- Throttle: same interval pattern as the other sweeps (env-gated, e.g. GOPI_CLEANUP_INTERVAL, default e.g. 5-15min).
- IMPORTANT guard: a Bond that commits AGAIN to an already-merged branch (continuing work after its task was closed) must not be interrupted — the "corresponding task terminal + worktree clean + HEAD == merged tip" triple-check covers this (a new commit makes HEAD != merged tip → skip).

## Deliverable
- Fix + tests: (a) merged branch + clean worktree + terminal task → removed (branch + worktree gone); (b) merged branch + dirty worktree → skipped untouched; (c) merged branch + task in_progress (live Bond) → skipped; (d) Bond committed again after merge (HEAD != merged tip) → skipped.
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (e.g. feat/fix-merged-worktree-cleanup), commit to main repo.
- devdoc/bugfix-merged-worktree-cleanup-<date>.md.
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. After the fix, serve tick removes at least one currently-frozen merged branch + its worktree (12 candidates exist today: feat/fix-config-p1, feat/fix-home-settings-isolation, feat/fix-task-p1, feat/fix-task-run-double-exec, feat/fix-worker-help, feat/task-session-log-path, fix/task-run-broken-pipe, review/cli-* ×5 — those whose tasks are terminal).
2. Live-Bond worktrees (e.g. the currently running review/cli-vision if still active) are untouched.
3. `go test ./internal/tools/ ./cmd/agent/` green.
4. devdoc committed.

Repo: ~/work/GoPi. This closes the single-node closed loop's last gap: merge → cleanup → branch count actually decreases.

### t-1788329099
- created: 2026-09-02T06:04:59Z | epoch: 1788329099.0
- status: completed | tags: bug,cli | parent: 
- summary:
BUG: adoption merge gate never fires — deliverable.branch never backfilled (resubmit after worker -h misclaim)

- spec/payload:
BUG FIX: adoption merge gate never fires — deliverable.branch is never backfilled at task completion, so AdoptionSweep skips every branch. "Branch count never decreases" mystery (nick, 2026-09-02).

## Experimental evidence (serve restarted with --every 30s per nick's suggestion)
```
[serve] [adopt] scanned=11 adopted=0 dispatched=0 duped=0 skipped=11 failed=0
```
Serve's AdoptionSweep scans all 11 non-master branches every pass and skips ALL of them. Zero merges ever happen. This matches nick's observation: branch count never changes despite completed tasks and ready branches (feat/fix-config-p1 completed at 12:5x, NOT in master, worktree exists, clean).

## Root cause (verified by PA, DB + code)
1. AdoptionSweep's gate (internal/tools/task_adoption.go:181-191, adoptionTaskCompleted): a branch is adoptable ONLY if the ledger holds a COMPLETED task whose deliverable JSON carries `"branch": "<branch-name>"`.
2. BUT the writeback path never writes branch: TaskRunWriteback (internal/tools/tasks.go:2986) → TaskUpdateWithResult → updates status + result summary ONLY. The deliverable column keeps whatever the submitter wrote — and submitters (gopi task submit CLI / task_submit tool) write `{"repo": "..."}` with NO branch. M4.9-era comments claim "deliverable.branch backfilled by the executor at completion" — the code does not exist (comment-lie pattern again).
3. DB proof: of 452 completed tasks, exactly ONE has a branch in deliverable. Recent completed rows (t-1788307651, t-1788308476, t-1788307511) all carry only {"repo":...}.
4. Consequence: adoptionTaskCompleted returns false for every branch → skipped=11 forever → adoption (and the "auto-merge closed loop") is a dead mechanism. The 8 `adoption: merge` commits in master history are from 2026-09-01 03:47-04:01 (a window where some rows did carry branches, or were merged by other means) — nothing since.

## Fix (implementer picks the minimal correct one)
Option A (preferred — backfill at completion): when a task-run child completes, capture the branch it worked on and write it into the task's deliverable:
- The child knows its worktree branch. Cleanest seam: the child's session already records workdir (the worktree path). On TaskRunWriteback(completed), run `git -C <workdir> branch --show-current` (or the child exports its branch in the wrapper env — check whether GOPI_TASK_WRAPPER_ID seam can also carry the branch, or read the child session's session_start.workdir) and merge the branch into the existing deliverable JSON: {"repo":..., "branch": "<name>"}. Store the workdir somewhere reachable by the writeback (task row has session_id → session JSONL session_start.workdir; or the wrapper records cwd at claim).
- Effect: next AdoptionSweep tick pairs the completed task's branch → probe-merge → lands + branch -d (branch -d still fails while the worktree holds the branch — that is OK, merge landing is the win; the ref prune wart is already tolerated, see task_adoption.go:234-238).
Option B (relax the gate): adoption pairs a branch when (a) the branch is not in master AND (b) the branch's tip commit time is recent AND (c) there is a completed task whose auto mirror row / session workdir matches the branch. More magic; prefer A.
Note: review/docs-only branches (reports committed straight to a review/* branch) have NO task row at all — adoption by task-pairing will never pick them up. That is fine per the closed-loop design (reviews are manually merged/archived), but document it.

## Deliverable
- Fix + regression test: submit → run a fake child task in a worktree → completed → task's deliverable now carries branch=<worktree-branch>; AdoptionSweep then adopts the branch (probe-merge lands, master advances).
- GOPI.md rules: no magic numbers, build+test green, Rule 8 git add one-by-one, work in a worktree (e.g. feat/fix-deliverable-branch-backfill), commit to main repo.
- devdoc/bugfix-deliverable-branch-<date>.md with the experimental evidence, root-cause chain, fix, and the post-fix verification recipe (serve --every 30s → [adopt] adopted=N>0).
- FINAL message MUST declare: branch name + recovery command + confirmation commit is in main repo.

## Acceptance (machine-checkable)
1. A completed task run leaves deliverable.branch set (assert in test).
2. serve --every 30s shows [adopt] adopted>=1 for the ready branch within a couple of ticks, master advances.
3. `go test ./internal/tools/ ./cmd/agent/` green.
4. devdoc committed.

Repo: ~/work/GoPi. This unblocks the single-node closed loop (auto-merge was silently dead).
